scoring_justification: The headline Tc is a reported scalar; recomputing from raw DFT logs is infeasible in a lightweight verifier. Scoring compares agent-reported Tc, λ, ω_log to paper values with tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold Tc, λ, ω_log values from the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: Tc=12 K at 90 GPa (abstract and main text). Fig. 3 inset gives λ ~ 0.7 and ω_log ~ 600 K at 90 GPa.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Read directly from the paper; rounded to one decimal for Tc and λ, to nearest integer for ω_log.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Directly from the paper’s reported numbers.

outputs.description: Superconducting critical temperature Tc (K), electron-phonon coupling constant λ (dimensionless), logarithmic average phonon frequency ω_log (K) computed for hcp PtH-II at 90 GPa using the Allen-Dynes modified McMillan equation with μ*=0.13.

output_contract.notes: Tc is the primary scored quantity; λ and ω_log serve as consistency checks. The hidden checker compares these values to paper-reported references with appropriate tolerances.

steps.note: Primary headline quantity – superconducting critical temperature
